dn16:4.13.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Bhoganagare yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi: ‘
dn16:4.13.2: Āyām' Ānanda yena Pāvā ten' upasaṃkamissāmāti.'
dn16:4.13.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:4.13.4: Atha kho Bhagavā mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ yena Pāvā tad avasari.
dn16:4.13.5: Tatra sudaṃ Bhagavā Pāvāyaṃ viharati Cundassa kammāra-puttassa ambavane. 14.
dn16:4.14.1: Assosi kho Cundo kammāra-putto: ‘Bhagavā kira Pāvaṃ anuppatto Pāvāyaṃ viharati mayhaṃ ambavane' ti.
dn16:4.14.2: Atha kho Cundo kammāra-putto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
dn16:4.14.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Cundaṃ kammāra-puttaṃ Bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi. 15.
dn16:4.14.4: Atha kho Cundo kammāra-putto Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.15.1: ‘Adhivāsetu me bhante Bhagavā svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṃghenāti.'
dn16:4.16.1: Atha kho Cundo kammāra-putto Bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā, uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. 17.
dn16:4.17.1: Atha kho Cundo kammāra-putto tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā pahūtañ ca sūkara-maddavaṃ Bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn16:4.18.1: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaram ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhu-saṃghena yena Cundassa kammāra-puttassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi,
dn16:4.18.2: nisajja kho Bhagavā Cundaṃ kammāra-puttaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.18.3: ‘Yan te Cunda sūkara-maddavaṃ paṭiyattaṃ, tena maṃ parivisa,
dn16:4.18.4: yaṃ pan' aññaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ , tena bhikkhu-saṃghaṃ parivisāti.'
dn16:4.18.5: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Cundo kammāra-putto Bhagavato paṭissutvā, yaṃ ahosi sūkara-maddavaṃ paṭiyattaṃ , tena Bhagavantaṃ parivisi,
dn16:4.18.6: yaṃ pan' aññaṃ khādaniyaṃ bhojaniyaṃ paṭiyattaṃ tena bhikkhu-saṃghaṃ parivisi. 19.
dn16:4.19.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Cundaṃ kammāra-puttaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.19.2: ‘Yan te Cunda sūkara-maddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ, taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇāhi,
dn16:4.19.3: nāhan taṃ Cunda passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadeva-manussāya yassa taṃ paribhuttaṃ sammāpariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra Tathāgatassāti.'
dn16:4.19.4: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Cundo kammāra-putto Bhagavato paṭissutvā, yaṃ ahosi sūkara-maddavaṃ avasiṭṭhaṃ taṃ sobbhe nikhaṇitvā, yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
dn16:4.19.5: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Cundaṃ kammāraputtaṃ Bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā pakkāmi. 20.
dn16:4.20.1: Atha kho Bhagavato Cundassa kammāra-puttassa bhattaṃ bhuttāvissa kharo ābādho uppajji lohita-pakkhandikā pabāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇantikā.
dn16:4.20.2: Tā sudaṃ Bhagavā sato sampajāno adhivāsesi avihaññamāno.
dn16:4.20.3: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.20.5: ‘Evam bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:4.21.1: Atha kho Bhagavā maggā okkamma yen' aññataraṃ rukkha-mūlaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.21.2: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ Ānanda catugguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpehi, kilanto 'smi Ānanda, nisīdissāmīti.'
dn16:4.21.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā catugguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpesi. 22.
dn16:4.22.1: nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi,
dn16:4.22.2: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ Ānanda pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsito 'smi, Ānanda, pivissāmīti.'
dn16:4.22.3: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.22.4: ‘Idāni bhante pañcamattāni sakaṭa-satāni atikkantāni, taṃ cakka-cchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
dn16:4.22.5: Ayaṃ bhante Kakutthā nadī avidūre acchodikā sātodikā sītodikā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā.
dn16:4.22.6: Ettha Bhagavā pānīyañ ca pivissati, gattāni ca sītaṃ karissatīti.' 23.
dn16:4.23.1: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.23.2: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ Ānanda pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsito 'smi Ānanda, pivissāmīti.'
dn16:4.23.3: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.23.4: ‘Idāni bhante pañcamattāni sakaṭa-satāni atikkantāni. Taṃ cakka-cchinnaṃ udakaṃ parittaṃ luḷitaṃ āvilaṃ sandati.
dn16:4.23.5: Ayaṃ bhante Kakutthā nadī avidūre acchodikā sātodikā sītodikā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā.
dn16:4.23.6: Ettha Bhagavā pānīyañ ca pivissati, gattāni ca sītaṃ karissatīti.' 24.
dn16:4.24.1: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.24.2: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ Ānanda pānīyaṃ āhara, pipāsito 'smi Ānanda, pivissāmīti.'
dn16:4.24.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā pattaṃ gahetvā yena sā nadikā ten' upasaṃkami.
dn16:4.24.4: Atha kho sā nadikā cakka-cchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā āyasmante Ānande upasaṃkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha. 25.
dn16:4.25.1: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
dn16:4.25.2: "Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho, Tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā!
dn16:4.25.3: Ayaṃ hi sā nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā, mayi upasaṃkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandatīti!'
dn16:4.25.4: Pattena pānīyaṃ ādāya yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.25.5: ‘Acchariyaṃ bhante abbhutaṃ bhante Tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā!
dn16:4.25.6: Idāni sā bhante nadikā cakkacchinnā parittā luḷitā āvilā sandamānā, mayi upasaṃkamante acchā vippasannā anāvilā sandittha!
dn16:4.25.7: Pivatu Bhagavā pānīyaṃ, pivatu Sugato pānīyan' ti.
dn16:4.26.1: Tena kho pana samayena Pukkuso Malla-putto Āḷārassa Kālāmassa sāvako Kusinārāya Pāvaṃ addhānamagga-paṭipanno hoti.
dn16:4.26.2: Addasā kho Pukkuso Malla-putto Bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkha-mūle nisinnaṃ,
dn16:4.26.3: disvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Pukkuso Malla-putto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.26.4: ‘Acchariyaṃ bhante, abbhutaṃ bhante, santena vata bhante pabbajitā vihārena viharanti! 27.
dn16:4.27.1: ‘Bhūta-pubbaṃ bhante Āḷāro Kālāmo addhānamagga-paṭipanno maggā okkamma avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkha-mūle divā-vihāre nisīdi.
dn16:4.27.2: Atha kho bhante pañcamattāni sakaṭa-satāni Āḷāraṃ Kālāmaṃ nissāya nissāya atikkamiṃsu.
dn16:4.27.3: Atha kho bhante aññataro puriso tassa sakaṭa-satthassa piṭṭhito āgacchanto yena Āḷāro Kālāmo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Āḷāraṃ Kālāmaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.27.7: "‘Na kho ahaṃ āvuso saddaṃ assosin" ti.
dn16:4.27.9: "‘Na kho ahaṃ āvuso sutto ahosin" ti.
dn16:4.27.12: ‘So tvaṃ bhante saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭa -satāni nissāya nissāya atikkamantāni n' eva addasa na pana saddaṃ assosi,
dn16:4.27.13: api hi te bhante saṃghāṭi rajena okiṇṇā' ti.
dn16:4.27.15: ‘Atha kho bhante tassa purisassa etad ahosi:
dn16:4.27.16: "Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho! Santena vata bho pabbajitā vihārena viharanti
dn16:4.27.17: yatra hi nāma saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭa-satāni nissāya nissāya atikkamantāni n' eva dakkhiti na pana saddaṃ sossatīti."
dn16:4.27.18: Āḷāre Kālāme uḷāraṃ pasādaṃ pavedetvā pakkāmīti.' 28.
dn16:4.28.2: Kataman nu kho dukkarataraṃ vā durabhisambhavataraṃ vā.
dn16:4.28.3: yo saññī samāno jāgaro pañcamattāni sakaṭa-satāni nissāya nissāya atikkamantāni n' eva passeyya na pana saddaṃ suṇeyya,
dn16:4.28.4: yo vā saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n' eva passeyya na pana saddaṃ suṇeyyāti?' 29.
dn16:4.29.1: ‘Kiṃ hi bhante tāni karissanti pañca vā sakaṭasatāni cha vā sakaṭa-satāni satta vā sakaṭa-satāni aṭṭha vā sakaṭa-satāni nava vā sakaṭa-satāni dasa vā sakaṭasatāni sakaṭa-sataṃ vā sakaṭa-sahassaṃ vā?
dn16:4.29.2: Atha kho etad eva dukkarataraṃ c' eva durabhisambhavatarañ ca yo saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n' eva passeyya na saddaṃ suṇeyyāti.' 30.
dn16:4.30.1: ‘Ekaṃ idāhaṃ Pukkusa samayaṃ Ātumāyaṃ viharāmi Bhusāgāre.
dn16:4.30.2: Tena kho pana samayena deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā Bhusāgārassa dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balivaddā.
dn16:4.30.3: Atha kho Pukkusa Ātumāya mahā-jana-kāyo nikkhamitvā yena te dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balivaddā ten' upasaṃkami. 31.
dn16:4.31.1: Tena kho panāhaṃ Pukkusa samayena Bhusāgārā nikkhamitvā Bhusāgāra-dvāre abbhokāse caṃkamāmi.
dn16:4.31.2: Atha kho Pukkusa aññataro puriso tamhā mahā-janakāyā yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi, ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho ahaṃ Pukkusa taṃ purisaṃ etad avocaṃ: 32.
dn16:4.32.1: "‘Kin nu kho so āvuso mahā-jana-kāyo sannipatito"? ti.
dn16:4.32.2: "‘Idāni bhante deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā dve kassakā bhātaro hatā cattāro ca balivaddā.
dn16:4.32.5: "‘Idh' eva kho ahaṃ āvuso ahosin" ti.
dn16:4.32.9: "‘Na kho ahaṃ āvuso saddaṃ assosin" ti.
dn16:4.32.11: "‘Na kho ahaṃ āvuso sutto ahosin" ti.
dn16:4.32.14: "‘So tvaṃ bhante saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n' eva addasa na pana saddaṃ assosīti."
dn16:4.33.1: ‘Atha kho Pukkusa tassa purisassa etad ahosi:
dn16:4.33.2: "Acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho! Santena vata bho pabbajitā vihārena viharanti
dn16:4.33.3: yatra hi nāma saññī samāno jāgaro deve vassante deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjutāsu niccharantīsu asaniyā phalantiyā n' eva dakkhiti na pana saddaṃ sossatīti."
dn16:4.33.4: Mayi uḷāraṃ pasādaṃ pavedetvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmīti.' 34.
dn16:4.34.1: Evaṃ vutte Pukkuso Malla-putto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.34.2: ‘Esāhaṃ bhante yo me Āḷāre Kāḷāme pasādo taṃ mahā-vāte vā opunāmi sīgha-sotāya vā nadiyā pavāhemi.
dn16:4.34.4: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā tela-pajjotam dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam eva Bhagavatā aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito!
dn16:4.34.5: Esāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi Dhammañ ca Bhikkhu-Saṃghañ ca.
dn16:4.34.6: Upāsakaṃ maṃ Bhagavā dhāretu ajjat' agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan' ti. 35.
dn16:4.35.1: Atha kho Pukkuso Malla-putto aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.35.2: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ bhaṇe siṅgi-vaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āharāti.'
dn16:4.35.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho so puriso Pukkusassa Malla-puttassa paṭissutvā taṃ siṅgi-vaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āhari.
dn16:4.35.4: Atha kho Pukkuso Malla-putto taṃ siṅgi-vaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ Bhagavato upanāmesi:
dn16:4.35.5: ‘Idaṃ bhante siṅgi-vaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ, tam me bhante Bhagavā paṭigaṇhātu anukampaṃ upādāyāti.'
dn16:4.35.6: ‘Tena hi Pukkusa ekena maṃ acchādehi ekena Ānandan' ti.
dn16:4.35.7: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Pukkuso Malla-putto Bhagavato paṭissutvā ekena Bhagavantaṃ acchādesi, ekena āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ. 36.
dn16:4.36.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Pukkusaṃ Malla-puttaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
dn16:4.36.2: Atha kho Pukkuso Malla-putto Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. 37.
dn16:4.37.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando acira-pakkante Pukkuse Malla-putte taṃ siṅgi-vaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ Bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmesi,
dn16:4.37.2: taṃ Bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitaṃ vītaccikaṃ viya khāyati.
dn16:4.37.3: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:4.37.4: ‘Acchariyaṃ bhante, abbhutaṃ bhante, yāva parisuddho bhante Tathāgatassa chavi-vaṇṇo pariyodāto!
dn16:4.37.5: Idaṃ bhante siṅgi-vaṇṇaṃ yugaṃ maṭṭaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ Bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmesiṃ, taṃ Bhagavato kāyaṃ upanāmitaṃ vītaccikaṃ viya khāyatīti' !
dn16:4.37.6: ‘Evam etaṃ Ānanda. Dvīsu kho Ānanda kālesu ativiya Tathāgatassa parisuddho hoti chavi-vaṇṇo pariyodāto.
dn16:4.38.2: Yañ ca Ānanda rattiṃ Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañ ca rattiṃ anupādisesāya nibbāna-dhātuyā parinibbāyati,
dn16:4.38.3: imesu kho Ānanda dvīsu kālesu ativiya Tathāgatassa parisuddho hoti chavi-vaṇṇo pariyodāto. 38.
dn16:4.38.4: ‘Ajja kho pan' Ānanda rattiyā pacchima-yāme Kusinārāyaṃ Upavattane Mallānaṃ sāla-vane antarena yamaka-sālānaṃ Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:4.38.5: Āyām' Ānanda yena Kakutthā nadī ten' upasaṃkamissāmāti.'
dn16:4.38.6: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:4.39.1: Atha kho Bhagavā mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ yena Kakutthā nadī ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Kakutthaṃ nadiṃ ajjhogāhetvā nahatvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā yena Ambavanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami,
dn16:4.39.3: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ Cundaka catugguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpehi, kilanto 'smi Cundaka, nipajjissāmīti.'
dn16:4.40.1: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Cundako Bhagavato paṭissutvā catugguṇaṃ saṃghāṭiṃ paññāpesi. 40.
dn16:4.40.2: Atha kho Bhagavā dakkhiṇena passena sīha-seyyaṃ kappesi, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
dn16:4.40.3: Āyasmā pana Cundako tatth' eva Bhagavato purato nisīdi. 41.
dn16:4.42.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:4.42.2: ‘Siyā kho pan' Ānanda Cundassa kammāra-puttassa koci vippaṭisāraṃ upadaheyya:
dn16:4.42.3: "Tassa te āvuso Cunda alābhā, tassa te dulladdhaṃ, yassa te Tathāgato pacchimaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā parinibbuto" ti.
dn16:4.42.4: Cundassa Ānanda kammāra-puttassa evaṃ vippaṭisāro paṭivinetabbo:
dn16:4.42.5: "‘Tassa te āvuso lābhā, tassa te suladdhaṃ,
dn16:4.42.6: yassa te Tathāgato pacchimaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā parinibbuto.
dn16:4.42.7: Sammukhā me taṃ āvuso Cunda Bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahītaṃ,
dn16:4.42.8: dve 'me piṇḍapātā samasamaphalā samasama-vipākā ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā ca.
dn16:4.42.10: Yañ ca piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhati, yañ ca piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitvā Tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbāna-dhātuyā parinibbāyati.
dn16:4.42.11: Ime dve piṇḍapātā samasama-phalā samasama-vipākā ativiya aññehi piṇḍapātehi mahapphalatarā ca mahānisaṃsatarā ca.
dn16:4.42.12: Āyu-saṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā Cundena kammāra-puttena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, vaṇṇa-saṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā Cundena kammāra-puttena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, sukha-saṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā Cundena kammāra-puttena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, yasa-saṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā Cundena kammāra-puttena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, sagga-saṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā Cundena kammāraputtena kammaṃ upacitaṃ, ādhipateyya-saṃvattanikaṃ āyasmatā Cundena kammāra-puttena kammaṃ upacitan" ti.
dn16:4.42.13: ‘Cundassa Ānanda kammāra-puttassa evaṃ vippāṭisāro paṭivinetabbo' ti. 43.
dn16:4.43.1: Atha kho Bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imam udānaṃ udānesi:
dn16:5.1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.1.2: ‘Āyām' Ānanda yena Hiraññavatiyā nadiyā pārimatīraṃ yena Kusinārā Upavattanaṃ Mallānaṃ sāla-vanaṃ ten' upasaṃkamissāmāti.'
dn16:5.1.3: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi.
dn16:5.1.4: Atha kho Bhagavā mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ yena Hiraññavatiyā nadiyā pārima-tīraṃ yena Kusinārā Upavattanaṃ Mallānaṃ sāla-vanaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.1.5: ‘Iṅgha me tvaṃ Ānanda antarena yamaka- sālānaṃ uttara-sīsakaṃ mañcakaṃ paññāpehi, kilanto 'smi Ānanda, nipajjissāmīti.'
dn16:5.1.6: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā antarena yamaka-sālānaṃ uttara-sīsakaṃ mañcakaṃ paññāpesi.
dn16:5.1.7: Atha kho Bhagavā dakkhiṇena passena sīha-seyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno. 2.
dn16:5.2.1: Tena kho pana samayena yamaka-sālā sabba-phāliphullā honti akāla-pupphehi.
dn16:5.2.2: Te Tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.3: Dibbāni pi mandārava-pupphāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni Tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.4: Dibbāni pi candana-cuṇṇāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni Tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.5: Dibbāni pi turiyāni antalikkhe vajjenti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.2.6: Dibbāni pi saṅgītāni antalikkhe vattanti Tathāgatassa pūjāya. 3.
dn16:5.3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.3.3: Tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.4: Dibbāni pi mandārava-pupphāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni Tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti Tathāgatassa pūjāya,
dn16:5.3.5: dibbāni pi candana-cuṇṇāni antalikkhā papatanti, tāni Tathāgatassa sarīraṃ okiranti ajjhokiranti abhippakiranti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.6: Dibbāni pi turiyāni antalikkhe vajjenti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.7: Dibbāni pi saṅgītāni antalikkhe vattanti Tathāgatassa pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.8: ‘Na kho Ānanda ettāvatā Tathāgato sakkato vā hoti garukato vā mānito vā pūjito vā apacito vā.
dn16:5.3.9: Yo kho Ānanda bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā upāsako vā upāsikā vā dhammānudhamma-paṭipanno viharati sāmīci -paṭipanno anudhamma-cārī, so Tathāgataṃ sakkaroti garukaroti māneti pūjeti paramāya pūjāya.
dn16:5.3.10: Tasmāt ih' Ānanda "dhammānudhamma-paṭipannā viharissāma sāmīci -paṭipannā anudhamma-cārino" ti, evaṃ
dn16:5.4.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upavāṇo Bhagavato purato ṭhito hoti Bhagavantaṃ vījamāno.
dn16:5.4.2: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upavāṇaṃ apasādesi:
dn16:5.4.4: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
dn16:5.4.5: ‘Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Upavāṇo dīgha-rattaṃ Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpa-cārī.
dn16:5.4.6: Atha ca pana Bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ Upavāṇaṃ apasādesi:
dn16:5.4.8: Ko nu kho hetu ko paccayo yaṃ Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upavāṇaṃ apasādesi:
dn16:5.5.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.5.2: ‘Ayaṃ bhante āyasmā Upavāṇo dīgha-rattaṃ Bhagavato upaṭṭhāko santikāvacaro samīpa-cārī,
dn16:5.5.3: atha ca pana Bhagavā pacchime kāle āyasmantaṃ Upavāṇaṃ apasādeti:
dn16:5.5.5: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yaṃ Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Upavāṇaṃ apasādesi:
dn16:5.5.7: ‘Yebhuyyena Ānanda dasasu loka-dhātusu devatā sannipatitā Tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
dn16:5.5.8: Yāvatā Ānanda Kusinārā Upavattanaṃ Mallānaṃ sāla-vanaṃ samantato dvādasa yojanāni n' atthi so padeso vālagga-koṭi-nittud anamatto pi mahesakkhāhi devatāhi apphuṭo.
dn16:5.5.11: Kadāci karahaci Tathāgatā loke uppajjanti arahanto sammā-sambuddhā, ajja
dn16:5.5.12: ca rattiyā pacchima-yāme Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati,
dn16:5.5.13: ayañ ca mahesakkho bhikkhu Bhavagato purato ṭhito ovārento, na mayaṃ labhāma pacchime kāle Tathāgataṃ dassanāyāti"
dn16:5.6.1: devatā Ānanda ujjhāyantīti.' 6. ‘Kathaṃ-bhūtā pana bhante Bhagavā devatā manasikarotīti' ?
dn16:5.6.2: ‘Sant' Ānanda devatā ākāse paṭhavi-saññiniyo, kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:5.6.3: "Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatīti!"
dn16:5.6.4: ‘Sant' Ānanda devatā paṭhaviyā paṭhavi-saññiniyo, kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papā taṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:5.6.5: "Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatīti!"
dn16:5.6.6: Yā pana tā devatā vīta-rāgā, tā satā sampajānā adhivāsenti:
dn16:5.6.7: "Aniccā saṃkhārā, taṃ kut' ettha labbā?" ti.' 7.
dn16:5.7.1: ‘Pubbe bhante disāsu vassaṃ vutthā bhikkhū āgacchanti Tathāgataṃ dassanāya,
dn16:5.7.2: te mayaṃ labhāma manobhāvanīye bhikkhū dassanāya labhāma payirupāsanāya.
dn16:5.7.3: Bhagavato pana mayaṃ bhante accayena na labhissāma manobhāvanīye bhikkhū dassanāya na labhissāma payirupāsanāyāti.' 8.
dn16:5.8.1: ‘Cattār' imāni Ānanda saddhassa kula-puttassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
dn16:5.8.3: "‘Idha Tathāgato jāto" ti Ānanda saddhassa kulaputtassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.4: "‘Idha Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammā-sambodhiṃ abhisambuddho" ti Ānanda saddhassa kula-puttassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.5: "‘Idha Tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhamma-cakkaṃ pavattitan" ti Ānanda saddhassa kula-puttassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.6: "‘Idha Tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbāna-dhātuyā parinibbuto" ti Ānanda saddhassa kula-puttassa dassanīyaṃ saṃvejanīyaṃ ṭhānaṃ.
dn16:5.8.7: ‘Imāni kho Ānanda cattāri saddhassa kula-puttassa dassanīyāni saṃvejanīyāni ṭhānāni.
dn16:5.8.8: Āgamissanti kho Ānanda saddhā bhikkhu-bhikkhuniyo upāsaka-upāsikāyo
dn16:5.8.9: "Idha Tathāgato jāto" ti pi, "‘Idha Tathāgato anuttaraṃ sammā-sambodhiṃ abhisambuddho" ti pi, "Idha Tathāgatena anuttaraṃ dhamma-cakkaṃ pavattitan" ti pi, "Idha Tathāgato anupādisesāya nibbānadhātuyā parinibbuto" ti pi.
dn16:5.8.10: ‘Ye hi keci Ānanda cetiya-cārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā pasannacittā kālaṃ karissanti, sabbe te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjissantīti.' 9.
dn16:5.10.2: ‘Avyāvaṭā tumhe Ānanda hotha Tathāgatassa sarīra pūjāya ,
dn16:5.10.3: iṅgha tumhe Ānanda sadatthe ghaṭatha, sadattham anuyuñjatha, sadatthe appamattā ātāpino pahitattā viharatha.
dn16:5.10.4: Sant' Ānanda khattiya-paṇḍitā pi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā pi gahapati-paṇḍitā pi Tathāgate abhippasannā, te Tathāgatassa sarīra-pūjaṃ karissantīti.' 11.
dn16:5.11.1: ‘Kathaṃ pana bhante Tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabban ?' ti.
dn16:5.11.2: ‘Yathā kho Ānanda rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ Tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabban' ti.
dn16:5.11.3: ‘Kathaṃ pana bhante rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjantīti ' ?
dn16:5.11.4: ‘Rañño Ānanda cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhenti. Ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti.
dn16:5.11.5: Etena upāyena pañcahi yuga-satehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā ayasāya tela-doṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā ayasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjetvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti,
dn16:5.11.7: Evaṃ kho Ānanda rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti.
dn16:5.11.8: ‘Yathā kho Ānanda rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti evaṃ Tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
dn16:5.11.10: Tattha ye mālaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā vaṇṇakaṃ vā āropessanti abhivādessanti vā, cittaṃ vā pasādessanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. 12.
dn16:5.12.3: ‘Tathāgato Arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho thūpāraho, Pacceka-Buddho thūpāraho, Tathāgata-sāvako thūpāraho, rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho. ‘Katamañ c'
dn16:5.12.4: Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca Tathāgato Arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.5: "Ayaṃ tassa Bhagavato arahato Sammā-Sambuddhassa thūpo" ti Ānanda bahujano cittaṃ pasādeti,
dn16:5.12.6: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjanti.
dn16:5.12.7: Idaṃ kho Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca Tathāgato Arahaṃ Sammā-Sambuddho thūpāraho. ‘
dn16:5.12.8: Katamañ c' Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca PaccekaSambuddho thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.9: "Ayaṃ tassa Bhagavato Pacceka-Sambuddhassa thūpo" ti Ānanda bahu-jano cittaṃ pasādeti,
dn16:5.12.10: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjanti.
dn16:5.12.11: Idaṃ kho Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca Pacceka-Sambuddho thūpāraho.
dn16:5.12.12: ‘Katamañ c' Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca Tathāgatasāvako thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.13: "Ayaṃ tassa Bhagavato Arahato Sammā-Sambuddhassa sāvaka-thūpo" ti Ānanda bahujano cittaṃ pasādeti,
dn16:5.12.14: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjanti.
dn16:5.12.15: Idaṃ kho Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca Tathāgata-sāvako thūpāraho. ‘
dn16:5.12.16: Katamañ c' Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho?
dn16:5.12.17: "Ayaṃ tassa dhammikassa dhammarañño thūpo" ti Ānanda bahu-jano cittaṃ pasādeti,
dn16:5.12.18: te tattha cittaṃ pasādetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajjanti.
dn16:5.12.19: Idaṃ kho Ānanda attha-vasaṃ paṭicca rājā cakkavattī thūpāraho.
dn16:5.13.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno aṭṭhāsi: "
dn16:5.13.2: Ahañ ca vat' amhi sekho sakaraṇīyo, Satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati yo mamaṃ anukampako' ti.
dn16:5.13.5: ‘Eso bhante āyasmā Ānando vihāraṃ pavisitvā kapisīsaṃ ālambitvā rodamāno ṭhito:
dn16:5.13.6: "Ahañ ca vat' amhi sekho sakaraṇīyo, Satthu ca me parinibbānaṃ bhavissati yo mamaṃ anukampako" ti.'
dn16:5.13.7: Atha kho Bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.13.8: ‘Ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu, mama vacanena Ānandam āmantehi:
dn16:5.13.10: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho so bhikkhu Bhagavato paṭissutvā yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.14.1: ‘Evaṃ āvuso' ti kho āyasmā Ānando tassa bhikkhuno paṭissutvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. 14. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:
dn16:5.14.2: ‘Alaṃ Ānanda mā soci mā paridevi. Na nu etaṃ Ānanda mayā paṭigacc' eva akkhātaṃ,
dn16:5.14.3: sabbeh' eva piyehi manāpehi nānā-bhāvo vinā-bhāvo aññathā-bhāvo?
dn16:5.14.4: Taṃ kut' ettha Ānanda labbhā? yan taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ paloka-dhammaṃ, taṃ vata mā palujjīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn16:5.14.5: Dīgha-rattaṃ kho te Ānanda Tathāgato paccupaṭṭhito mettena kāya-kammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena, mettena vacī-kammena . . . pe . . . mettena mano-kammena hitena sukhena advayena appamāṇena.
dn16:5.14.6: Katapuñño 'si tvaṃ Ānanda. Padhānaṃ anuyuñja khippaṃ hohisi anāsavo' ti. 15.
dn16:5.15.2: ‘Ye pi te bhikkhave ahesuṃ atītam addhānaṃ arahanto sammā-sambuddhā, tesam pi Bhagavantānaṃ eta-paramā yeva upaṭṭhākā ahesuṃ seyyathā pi mayhaṃ Ānando
dn16:5.15.3: Ye pi te bhikkhave bhavissanti anāgatam addhānaṃ arahanto sammā-sambuddhā, tesam pi Bhagavantānaṃ eta-paramā yeva upaṭṭhākā bhavissanti seyyathā pi mayhaṃ Ānando.
dn16:5.15.6: jānāti: "Ayaṃ kālo Tathāgataṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamituṃ bhikkhūnaṃ, ayaṃ kālo bhikkhunīnaṃ, ayaṃ kālo upāsakānaṃ, ayaṃ kālo upāsikānaṃ, ayaṃ kālo rañño rāja-mahāmattānaṃ titthiyānaṃ titthiya-sāvakānan" ti. 16.
dn16:5.16.3: ‘Sace bhikkhave bhikkhu-parisā Ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.4: tatra ce Ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.5: atittā 'va bhikkhave bhikkhu-parisā hoti atha Ānando tuṇhī hoti.
dn16:5.16.6: ‘Sace bhikkhave bhikkhunī-parisā . . . upāsaka-parisā . . . upāsikā-parisā Ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.7: tatra ce Ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.8: atittā 'va bhikkhave upāsikā -parisā hoti atha Ānando tuṇhī hoti.
dn16:5.16.16: bhikkhave acchariyā abbhutā dhammā raññe cakkavattimhi.
dn16:5.16.17: ‘Sace bhikkhave khattiya-parisā . . . brāhmaṇa-parisā . . . gahapati-parisā . . . samaṇa-parisā rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamati, dassanena sā attamanā hoti, tatra ce rājā cakkavattī bhāsati bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti, atittā 'va bhikkhave samaṇa-parisā hoti atha rājā cakkavattī tuṇhī hoti. ‘Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro
dn16:5.16.27: Sace bhikkhave bhikkhu-parisā bhikkhunī-parisā . . . upāsaka-parisā . . . upāsikā-parisā Ānandaṃ dassanāya upasaṃkamati, dassanena pi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.28: tatra ce Ānando dhammaṃ bhāsati bhāsitena pi sā attamanā hoti,
dn16:5.16.37: ‘Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā Ānande' ti. 17.
dn16:5.17.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.17.2: ‘Mā bhante Bhagavā imasmiṃ kuḍḍa-nagarake ujjaṅgala-nagarake sākha-nagarake parinibbāyatu.
dn16:5.17.3: Santi hi bhante aññāni mahā-nagarāni seyyathīdaṃ
dn16:5.17.4: Campā Rājagahaṃ Sāvatthi Sāketaṃ Kosambi Bārāṇasi.
dn16:5.17.6: ettha bahū khattiya-mahāsālā brāhmaṇa- mahāsālā gahapati-mahāsālā Tathāgate abhippasannā,
dn16:5.17.8: ‘Mā h' evaṃ Ānanda avaca, mā h' evaṃ Ānanda avaca
dn16:5.18.1: ‘Bhūta-pubbaṃ Ānanda Rājā Mahā-Sudassano nāma ahosi cakkavattī dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto satta-ratana-samannāgato.
dn16:5.18.2: Rañño Ānanda Mahā-Sudassanassa ayaṃ Kusinārā Kusāvātī nāma rājadhānī ahosi,
dn16:5.18.3: puratthimena ca pacchimena ca dvādasa yojanāni āyāmena uttarena ca dakkhiṇena ca satta yojanāni vitthārena.
dn16:5.18.4: ‘Kusāvatī Ānanda rājadhānī iddhā c' eva ahosi phītā ca bahu-janā ca ākiṇṇa-manussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn16:5.18.5: Seyyathā pi Ānanda devānaṃ Āḷakamandā nāma rājadhānī iddhā c' eva phītā ca bahu-janā ca ākiṇṇa-yakkhā ca subhikkhā ca,
dn16:5.18.6: evam eva kho Ānanda Kusāvatī rājadhānī iddhā c' eva ahosi phītā ca bahu-janā ca ākiṇṇa-manussā ca subhikkhā ca.
dn16:5.18.7: ‘Kusāvatī Ānanda rājadhānī dasahi saddehi avivittā ahosi divā c' eva rattī ca, seyyathīdaṃ
dn16:5.18.8: hatthi-saddena assa-saddena ratha-saddena bheri-saddena mutiṅga-saddena vīṇā-saddena gīta-saddena samma-saddena tālasaddena asnātha-pivatha-khādathāti dasamena saddena. 19.
dn16:5.19.1: ‘Gaccha tvaṃ Ānanda, Kusinārāyaṃ pavisitvā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ ārocehi:
dn16:5.19.2: "Ajja kho Vāseṭṭhā rattiyā pacchime yāme Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.19.5: Amhākañ ca no gāmakkhette Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ ahosi, na mayaṃ labhimhā pacchime kāle Tathāgataṃ dassanāyāti."'
dn16:5.19.6: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paṭissutvā nivāsetvā patta-cīvaraṃ ādāya atta-dutiyo Kusinārāyaṃ pāvisi. 20.
dn16:5.20.1: Tena kho pana samayena Kosinārakā Mallā santhāgāre sannipatitā honti kenacid eva karaṇīyena.
dn16:5.20.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ santhāgāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ ārocesi:
dn16:5.20.3: ‘Ajja kho Vāseṭṭhā rattiyā pacchime yāme Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.20.6: ‘Amhākañ ca no gāmakkhette Tathāgatassa parinibbānaṃ ahosi, na mayaṃ labhimhā pacchime kāle Tathāgataṃ dassanāyāti.' 21.
dn16:5.21.1: Idam āyasmato Ānandassa sutvā Mallā ca Mallaputtā ca Malla-suṇisā ca Malla-pajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā ceto-dukkha-samappitā app ekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:5.21.2: ‘Atikhippam Bhagavā parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbāyissati, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antaradhāyissatīti.'
dn16:5.21.3: Atha kho Mallā Malla-puttā ca Malla-suṇisā ca Mallapajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā ceto-dukkha-samappitā yena Upavattanaṃ Mallānaṃ sāla-vanaṃ yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu. 22.
dn16:5.22.1: Atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
dn16:5.22.2: ‘Sace kho ahaṃ Kosinārake Malle ekam-ekaṃ Bhagavantaṃ vandāpessāmi, avandito Bhagavā Kosinārakehi Mallehi bhavissati athāyaṃ ratti vibhāyissati.
dn16:5.22.3: Yan nūnāhaṃ Kosinārake Malle kula-parivattaso kula-parivattaso ṭhapetvā Bhagavantaṃ vandāpeyyaṃ:
dn16:5.22.4: "Itthannāmo bhante Mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti."'
dn16:5.22.5: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Kosinārake Malle kula-parivattaso kula-parivattaso ṭhapetvā Bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi:
dn16:5.22.6: ‘Itthannāmo bhante Mallo saputto sabhariyo sapariso sāmacco Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatīti.'
dn16:5.22.7: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando etena upāyena paṭhamen' eva yāmena Kosinārake Malle Bhagavantaṃ vandāpesi. 23.
dn16:5.23.1: Tena kho pana samayena Subhaddo nāma paribbājako Kusinārāyaṃ paṭivasati.
dn16:5.23.3: ‘Ajj' eva kira rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa Gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissatīti.'
dn16:5.23.4: Atha kho Subhaddassa paribbājakassa etad ahosi:
dn16:5.23.5: ‘Sutaṃ kho pana me taṃ paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn16:5.23.6: "Kadāci karahaci Tathāgatā loke uppajjanti Arahanto Sammā-Sambuddhā" ti. Ajja
dn16:5.23.7: ca rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa Gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.23.8: Atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhā-dhammo uppanno,
dn16:5.23.9: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe Gotame, pahoti me samaṇo Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhā-dhammaṃ pajaheyyan' ti. 24.
dn16:5.24.1: Atha kho Subhaddo paribbājako yena Upavattanaṃ Mallānaṃ sālavanaṃ yen' āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.24.2: ‘Sutaṃ me taṃ bho Ānanda paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn16:5.24.3: "Kadāci karahaci Tathāgatā loke uppajjanti Arahanto Sammā-Sambuddhā" ti. Ajja
dn16:5.24.4: ca rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa Gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.24.5: Atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhā-dhammo uppanno,
dn16:5.24.6: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe Gotame, pahoti me samaṇo Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhā-dhammaṃ pajaheyyaṃ.
dn16:5.24.7: Svāhaṃ bho Ānanda labheyyaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāyāti.'
dn16:5.24.8: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ānando Subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.24.9: ‘Alaṃ āvuso Subhadda, mā Tathāgataṃ viheṭhesi. Kilanto Bhagavā' ti.
dn16:5.24.10: Dutiyam pi kho Subhaddo paribbājako . . . pe . . .
dn16:5.24.11: Tatiyam pi kho Subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.24.12: ‘Sutaṃ me taṃ bho Ānanda paribbājakānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn16:5.24.13: "Kadāci karahaci Tathāgatā loke uppajjanti Arahanto Sammā-Sambuddhā" ti. Ajja
dn16:5.24.14: ca rattiyā pacchime yāme samaṇassa Gotamassa parinibbānaṃ bhavissati.
dn16:5.24.15: Atthi ca me ayaṃ kaṅkhā- dhammo uppanno,
dn16:5.24.16: evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ samaṇe Gotame, pahoti me samaṇo Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā ahaṃ imaṃ kaṅkhādhammaṃ pajaheyyaṃ.
dn16:5.24.17: Svāhaṃ bho Ānanda labheyyaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ dassanāyāti.'
dn16:5.24.18: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando Subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.24.19: ‘Alaṃ āvuso Subhadda, mā Tathāgataṃ viheṭhesi. Kilanto Bhagavā' ti. 25.
dn16:5.25.1: Assosi kho Bhagavā āyasmato Ānandassa Subhaddena paribbājakena saddhiṃ imaṃ kathā-sallāpaṃ.
dn16:5.25.2: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.25.3: ‘Alaṃ Ānanda, mā Subhaddaṃ vāresi, labhataṃ Ānanda Subhaddo Tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
dn16:5.25.4: Yaṃ kiñci maṃ Subhaddo pucchissati, sabban taṃ aññā-pekho 'va pucchissati no vihesā-pekho,
dn16:5.25.5: yañ c' assāhaṃ puṭṭho vyākarissāmi taṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti.'
dn16:5.25.6: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Subhaddaṃ paribbājakaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.25.7: ‘Gacch' āvuso Subhadda, karoti te Bhagavā okāsan' ti. 26.
dn16:5.26.1: Atha kho Subhaddo paribbājako yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Subhaddo paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca: 3
dn16:5.26.2: ‘Ye ' me bho Gotama samaṇa-brāhmaṇā saṃghino gaṇino gaṇācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhu-sammatā ca bahu-janassa,
dn16:5.26.3: seyyathīdaṃ Pūraṇo Kassapo, Makkhali Gosālo, Ajita-Kesakambalī, Pakudho Kaccāyano, Sañjayo Belaṭṭhi-putto, Nigaṇṭho Nātha-putto,
dn16:5.26.4: sabbe te sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññaṃsu, sabbe 'va na abbhaññaṃsu, ekacce abbhaññaṃsu ekacce na abbhaññaṃsūti' ? 1
dn16:5.26.6: "Sabbe te sakāya paṭiññāya abbhaññaṃsu, sabbe va na abbhaññaṃsu, udāhu ekacce abbhaññaṃsu ekacce na abbhaññaṃsūti?"
dn16:5.26.9: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho Subhaddo paribbājako Bhagavato paccassosi,
dn16:5.27.1: ‘Yasmiṃ kho Subhadda dhamma-vinaye Ariyo Aṭṭhaṅgiko Maggo na upalabbhati, samaṇo pi tattha na upalabbhati, dutiyo pi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati, tatiyo pi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati, catuttho pi tattha samaṇo na upalabbhati.
dn16:5.27.2: Yasmiñ ca kho Subhadda dhamma-vinaye Ariyo Aṭṭhaṅgiko Maggo upalabbhati, samaṇo pi tattha upalabbhati, dutiyo pi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati, tatiyo pi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati, catuttho pi tattha samaṇo upalabbhati.
dn16:5.27.3: Imasmiṃ kho Subhadda dhamma-vinaye Ariyo Aṭṭhaṅgiko Maggo upalabbhati, idh' eva Subhadda samaṇo, idha dutiyo samaṇo, idha tatiyo samaṇo, idha catuttho samaṇo. Suññā parappavādā samaṇehi aññe,
dn16:5.27.4: ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assa.
dn16:5.27.13: pi samaṇo n' atthi, catuttho pi samaṇo n' atthi.
dn16:5.27.15: ime ca Subhadda bhikkhū sammā vihareyyuṃ, asuñño loko arahantehi assāti.' 28.
dn16:5.28.1: Evaṃ vutte Subhaddo paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.28.3: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telappajotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam eva Bhagavatā aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn16:5.28.4: Esāhaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ ca bhikkhu-saṃghañ ca.
dn16:5.28.5: Labheyyāhaṃ Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyaṃ upasampadan' ti. 3
dn16:5.29.1: ‘Yo kho Subhadda añña-titthiya-pubbo imasmiṃ dhamma-vinaye ākaṅkhati pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhati upasampadaṃ, so cattāro māse parivasati. Catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddha-cittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhu-bhāvāya.
dn16:5.29.2: Api ca m' ettha puggala-vemattatā viditā' ti. 29.
dn16:5.29.3: ‘Sace bhante añña-titthiya-pubbā imasmiṃ dhamma-vinaye ākaṅkhantā pabbajjaṃ, ākaṅkhantā upasampadaṃ, cattāro māse parivasanti, catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddha-cittā bhikkhū pabbājenti upasampādenti bhikkhu-bhāvāya, ahaṃ cattāri vassāni parivasissāmi, catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena āraddha-cittā bhikkhū pabbājentu upasampādentu bhikkhu-bhāvāyāti.'
dn16:5.29.4: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:5.29.6: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavato paccassosi. 30.
dn16:5.30.1: Atha kho Subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:5.30.2: ‘Lābhā vo āvuso Ānanda, suladdhaṃ vo āvuso Ānanda,
dn16:5.30.3: ye ettha Satthārā sammukhā antevāsābhisekena abhisittā' ti.
dn16:5.30.4: Alattha kho Subhaddo paribbājako Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
dn16:5.30.5: Acirūpasampanno kho pan' āyasmā Subhaddo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto Na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariya-pariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe 'va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi:
dn16:5.30.6: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti' abbhaññāsi.
dn16:5.30.7: Aññataro kho pan' āyasmā Subhaddo arahataṃ ahosi.
dn16:6.1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:6.1.2: ‘Siyā kho pan' Ānanda tumhākam evam assa:
dn16:6.1.3: "Atītasatthukaṃ pāvacanaṃ, n' atthi no Satthā" ti.
dn16:6.1.4: Na kho pan' etaṃ Ānanda evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
dn16:6.1.5: Yo vo Ānanda mayā Dhammo ca Vinayo ca desito paññatto, so vo mam' accayena Satthā. 2.
dn16:6.2.1: ‘Yathā kho pan' Ānanda etarahi bhikkhū aññamaññaṃ āvuso-vādena samudācaranti, na vo mam' accayena evaṃ samudācaritabbaṃ.
dn16:6.2.2: Theratarena Ānanda bhikkhunā navakataro bhikkhu nāmena vā gottena vā āvuso-vādena vā samudācaritabbo,
dn16:6.2.3: navakatarena bhikkhunā therataro bhikkhu "bhante" ti vā "āyasmā" ti vā samudācaritabbo. 3.
dn16:6.3.1: ‘Ākaṅkhamāno Ānanda saṃgho mam' accayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhantu. 4.
dn16:6.4.1: ‘Channassa Ānanda bhikkhuno mam' accayena brahma-daṇḍo kātabbo' ti.
dn16:6.4.3: ‘Channo Ānanda bhikkhu yaṃ iccheyya taṃ vadeyya,
dn16:6.4.4: so bhikkhūhi n' eva vattabbo na ovaditabbo na anusāsitabbo' ti. 5.
dn16:6.5.2: ‘Siyā kho pana bhikkhave eka-bhikkhussa pi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā Buddhe vā dhamme vā saṃghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā. Pucchatha bhikkhave. Mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha:
dn16:6.5.3: "Sammukhī-bhūto no Satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimha Bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitun"' ti.
dn16:6.5.4: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn16:6.6.2: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn16:6.6.3: ‘Siyā kho pana bhikkhave eka-bhikkhussa pi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā Buddhe vā dhamme vā saṃghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā. Pucchatha bhikkhave. Mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha:
dn16:6.6.4: "Sammukhī-bhūto no Satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimha Bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitun"' ti.
dn16:6.6.5: Tatiyam pi kho te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
dn16:6.6.7: ‘Siyā kho pana bhikkhave Satthu-gāravena pi na puccheyyātha. Sahāyako pi bhikkhave sahāyakassa ārocetūti.'
dn16:6.6.8: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū tuṇhī ahesuṃ. 6.
dn16:6.6.9: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:6.6.10: ‘Acchariyaṃ bhante abbhutaṃ bhante! Evaṃ pasanno ahaṃ bhante imasmiṃ bhikkhu-saṃghe, n' atthi eka-bhikkhussa pi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā Buddhe vā dhamme vā saṃghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā' ti.
dn16:6.6.11: ‘Pasādā kho tvaṃ Ānanda vadesi. Ñāṇam eva h' ettha Ānanda Tathāgatassa: "N' atthi imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṃghe, n' atthi eka-bhikkhussa pi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā Buddhe vā dhamme vā saṃghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā.
dn16:6.6.12: Imesaṃ hi Ānanda pañcannaṃ bhikkhu-satānaṃ yo pacchimako bhikkhu so sotāpanno avinipāta-dhammo niyato sambodhi-parāyano' ti. 7.
dn16:6.8.1: Atha kho Bhagavā paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. Ākāsānañcāyatana -samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. Viññāṇañcāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. Ākiñcaññāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā n'eva-saññā -nāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. N'eva-saññā -nāsaññāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā saññā-vedayita-nirodhaṃ samāpajji.
dn16:6.8.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:6.8.4: āvuso Ānanda Bhagavā parinibbuto, saññā-vedayita-nirodhaṃ samāpanno' ti. 9.
dn16:6.9.1: Atha kho Bhagavā saññā-vedayita-nirodha-sampattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā n'eva-saññā -nāsaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. N'eva-saññā -nāsaññāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samāpajji. Ākiñcaññāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. Viññāṇañcāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samāpajji. Ākāsānañcāyatana-samāpattiyā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Paṭhamajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā dutiyajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Dutiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Tatiyajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā catutthajjhānaṃ samāpajji. Catutthajjhānā vuṭṭhahitvā samanantarā Bhagavā parinibbāyi. 10.
dn16:6.10.1: Parinibbute Bhagavati saha parinibbānā mahā bhūmi-cālo ahosi bhiṃsanako lomahaṃso deva-dundubhiyo ca phaliṃsu.
dn16:6.10.2: Parinibbute Bhagavati saha parinibbānā Brahmā Sahampati imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.9: Parinibbute Bhagavati saha parinibbānā Sakko devānam indo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.14: Parinibbute Bhagavati saha parinibbānā āyasmā Anuruddho imā gāthāyo abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.23: Parinibbute Bhagavati saha parinibbānā āyasmā Ānando imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi:
dn16:6.10.28: Parinibbute Bhagavati tattha ye te bhikkhū avīta-rāgā app ekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti: ‘Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahitan' ti.
dn16:6.10.29: Ye pana te bhikkhū vīta-rāgā te satā sampajānā adhivāsenti,
dn16:6.10.30: ‘Aniccā saṃkhārā, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā' ti. 11.
dn16:6.11.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn16:6.11.3: Na nu etaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā paṭigacc' eva akkhātaṃ,
dn16:6.11.4: sabbeh' eva piyehi manāpehi nānā-bhāvo vinā-bhāvo aññathābhāvo?
dn16:6.11.5: Taṃ kut' ettha āvuso labbhā? Yan taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ paloka-dhammaṃ taṃ vata mā palujjīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn16:6.11.7: ‘Kathaṃ-bhūtā pana bhante āyasmā Anuruddho devatā manasikarotīti?'
dn16:6.11.8: ‘Sant' āvuso Ānanda devatā ākāse paṭhavi-saññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinnapapātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:6.11.9: "Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahitan" ti.
dn16:6.11.10: ‘Sant' āvuso Ānando devatā paṭhaviyā paṭhavi-saññiniyo kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:6.11.11: "Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahitan" ti.
dn16:6.11.12: ‘Yā pana devatā vīta-rāgā tā satā sampajānā adhivā senti,
dn16:6.11.13: "Aniccā saṃkhārā, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā"' ti. 12.
dn16:6.11.14: Atha kho āyasmā ca Anuruddho āyasmā ca Ānando taṃ rattāvasesaṃ dhammiyā kathāya vītināmesuṃ.
dn16:6.12.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
dn16:6.12.2: ‘Gacch' āvuso Ānanda, Kusināraṃ pavisitvā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ ārocehi:
dn16:6.12.5: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho āyasmā Ānanda āyasmato Anuruddhassa paṭissutvā pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaraṃ ādāya atta-dutiyo Kusināraṃ pāvisi.
dn16:6.12.6: Tena kho pana samayena Kosinārakā Mallā santhāgāre sannipatitā honti ten' eva karaṇīyena.
dn16:6.12.7: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ santhāgāraṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ ārocesi:
dn16:6.12.10: Idam āyasmato Ānandassa sutvā Mallā ca Malla-puttā ca Malla-suṇisā ca Malla-pajāpatiyo ca aghāvino dummanā ceto-dukkha-samappitā app ekacce kese pakiriya kandanti, bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papātam papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:6.12.11: ‘Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahitan' ti. 13.
dn16:6.13.1: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā purise āṇāpesuṃ:
dn16:6.13.2: ‘Tena hi bhaṇe Kusinārāyaṃ gandha-mālañ ca sabbañ ca tāḷāvacaraṃ sannipātethāti.'
dn16:6.13.3: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā gandha-mālañ ca sabbañ ca tāḷāvacaraṃ pañca ca dussa-yuga-satāni ādāya yena Upavattanaṃ Mallānaṃ sāla-vanaṃ yena Bhagavato sarīraṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu , upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā cela-vitānāni karontā maṇḍala-mālāni paṭiyādentā evaṃ taṃ divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ.
dn16:6.13.4: Atha kho Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ etad ahosi:
dn16:6.13.5: "Ativikālo kho ajja Bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpetuṃ. Sve dāni mayaṃ Bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmāti.'
dn16:6.13.6: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā Bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā cela-vitānāni karontā maṇḍala-mālāni paṭiyādentā dutiyam pi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, tatiyam pi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, catuttham pi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, pañcamam pi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ, chaṭṭham pi divasaṃ vītināmesuṃ. 14.
dn16:6.14.1: Atha kho sattamaṃ divasaṃ Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ etad ahosi:
dn16:6.14.2: ‘Mayaṃ Bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, dakkhiṇena dakkhiṇaṃ nagarassa haritvā bāhirena bāhiraṃ dakkhiṇato nagarassa Bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmāti.'
dn16:6.14.3: Tena kho pana samayena aṭṭha Malla-pāmokkhā sīsaṃ nahātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā:
dn16:6.14.4: ‘Mayaṃ Bhagavato sarīraṃ uccāressāmāti,' na sakkonti uccāretuṃ.
dn16:6.14.5: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avocum:
dn16:6.14.6: ‘Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yena 'me aṭṭha Malla-pāmokkhā sīsaṃ nahātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā,
dn16:6.14.7: "Mayaṃ Bhagavato sarīraṃ uccāressāmāti," na sakkonti uccāretun'? ti.
dn16:6.14.8: ‘Aññathā kho Vāseṭṭhā tumhākaṃ adhippāyo, aññathā devatānaṃ adhippāyo' ti. 15.
dn16:6.15.3: "Mayaṃ Bhagavato sarīraṃ naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, dakkhiṇena dakkhiṇaṃ nagarassa haritvā, bāhirena bāhiraṃ dakkhiṇato nagarassa Bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmāti."
dn16:6.15.5: "Mayaṃ Bhagavato sarīraṃ dibbehi naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, uttarena uttaraṃ nagarassa haritvā, uttarena dvārena nagaraṃ pavesetvā, majjhena majjhaṃ nagarassa haritvā, puratthimena dvārena nikkhamitvā puratthimato nagarassa Makuṭa-bandhanaṃ nāma Mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ, ettha Bhagavato sarīraṃ jhāpessāmāti."'
dn16:6.16.1: Tena kho pana samayena Kusinārā yāva sandhisamala-saṅkaṭīrā jannu-mattena odhinā mandāravapupphehi santhatā hoti.
dn16:6.16.2: Atha kho devatā ca Kosinārakā ca Mallā Bhagavato sarīraṃ dibbehi ca mānusakehi ca naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkarontā garukarontā mānentā pūjentā, uttarena uttaraṃ nagarassa haritvā, uttarena dvārena nagaraṃ pavesetvā, majjhena majjhaṃ nagarassa haritvā, puratthimena dvārena nikkhamitvā -- puratthimato nagarassa Makuṭa-bandhanaṃ nāma Mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ -- ettha Bhagavato sarīraṃ nikkhipiṃsu. 17.
dn16:6.17.1: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avocum:
dn16:6.17.2: ‘Kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante Ānanda Tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjāmāti?'
dn16:6.17.3: ‘Yathā kho Vāseṭṭhā rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ Tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabban' ti.
dn16:6.17.4: ‘Kathaṃ pana bhante Ānanda rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjantīti?'
dn16:6.17.5: ‘Rañño Vāseṭṭhā cakkavattissa sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhenti, ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhenti, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhenti,
dn16:6.17.6: etena upāyena pañcahi yuga-satehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā ayasāya tela-doṇiyā pakkhipitvā, aññissā ayasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā, sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti,
dn16:6.17.8: Evaṃ kho Vāseṭṭhā rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti.
dn16:6.17.9: ‘Yathā kho Vāseṭṭhā rañño cakkavattissa sarīre paṭipajjanti, evaṃ Tathāgatassa sarīre paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
dn16:6.17.11: Tattha ye mālaṃ vā gandhaṃ vā vaṇṇakaṃ vā āropessanti, abhivādessanti vā, cittaṃ vā pasādessanti, tesaṃ taṃ bhavissati dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.' 18.
dn16:6.18.1: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā purise āṇāpesuṃ,
dn16:6.18.2: ‘Tena hi bhaṇe Mallānaṃ vihataṃ kappāsaṃ sannipātethāti.'
dn16:6.18.3: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā Bhagavato sarīraṃ ahatena vatthena veṭhesuṃ, ahatena vatthena veṭhetvā vihatena kappāsena veṭhesuṃ, vihatena kappāsena veṭhetvā ahatena vatthena veṭhesuṃ,
dn16:6.18.4: etena upāyena pañcahi yuga-satehi Bhagavato sarīraṃ veṭhetvā ayasāya tela-doṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā ayasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabba-gandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā Bhagavato sarīraṃ citakaṃ āropesuṃ. 19.
dn16:6.19.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Pāvāya Kusināraṃ addhāna-magga-paṭipanno hoti mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhu-satehi.
dn16:6.19.2: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
dn16:6.19.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññataro ājīvako Kusinārāya mandārava-pupphaṃ gahetvā Pāvaṃ addhāna-maggapaṭipanno hoti.
dn16:6.19.4: Addasā kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo ājīvakaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ. Disvā tam ājīvakaṃ etad avoca:
dn16:6.19.6: ‘Āma āvuso jānāmi. Ajja sattāha-parinibbuto samaṇo Gotamo.
dn16:6.19.7: Tato me idaṃ mandārava-pupphaṃ gahitan' ti.
dn16:6.19.8: Tattha ye te bhikkhū avīta-rāgā app ekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti, chinna-papātaṃ papatanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti:
dn16:6.19.9: ‘Atikhippaṃ Bhagavā parinibbuto, atikhippaṃ Sugato parinibbuto, atikhippam cakkhuṃ loke antarahitan' ti.
dn16:6.19.10: Ye pana te bhikkhū vīta-rāgā, te satā sampajānā adhivāsenti:
dn16:6.19.11: ‘Aniccā saṃkhārā, taṃ kut' ettha labbhā?' ti. 20.
dn16:6.20.1: Tena kho pana samayena Subhaddo nāma buḍḍhapabbajito tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
dn16:6.20.2: Atha kho Subhaddo buḍḍha-pabbajito te bhikkhū etad avoca:
dn16:6.20.3: ‘Alaṃ āvuso mā socittha mā paridevittha. Sumuttā mayaṃ tena mahā-samaṇena. Upaddutā ca homa
dn16:6.20.4: "Idaṃ vo kappati, idaṃ vo na kappatīti,"
dn16:6.20.5: idāni pana mayaṃ yaṃ icchissāma taṃ karissāma, yaṃ na icchissāma taṃ na karissāmāti.'
dn16:6.20.6: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn16:6.20.8: Nanu etaṃ āvuso Bhagavatā paṭigacc' eva akkhātaṃ:
dn16:6.20.9: "Sabbeh' eva piyehi manāpehi nānā-bhāvo vinā-bhāvo aññathā bhāvo,
dn16:6.20.10: taṃ kut' ettha āvuso labbhā? yan taṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ paloka-dhammaṃ, taṃ vata mā palujjīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti."' 21.
dn16:6.21.1: Tena kho pana samayena cattāro Malla-pāmokkhā sīsaṃ nahātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā:
dn16:6.21.2: ‘Mayaṃ Bhagavato citakaṃ ālimpessāmāti' na sakkonti ālimpetuṃ.
dn16:6.21.3: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā āyasmantaṃ Anuruddhaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn16:6.21.4: ‘Ko nu kho bhante Anuruddha hetu ko paccayo yena 'me cattāro Malla-pāmokkhā sīsaṃ nahātā ahatāni vatthāni nivatthā
dn16:6.21.5: ‘Mayaṃ Bhagavato citakaṃ ālimpessāmāti' na sakkonti ālimpetun?' ti.
dn16:6.21.9: "Ayaṃ āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Pāvāya Kusināraṃ addhāna-magga-paṭipanno mahatā bhikkhu-saṃghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhu-satehi,
dn16:6.21.10: na tāva Bhagavato citako pajjalissati yāv' āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo Bhagavato pāde sirasā na vandissatīti."'
dn16:6.22.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Kassapo yena Kusinārā Makuṭa-bandhanaṃ Mallānaṃ cetiyaṃ yena Bhagavato citako ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ citakaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā, pādato vivaritvā Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandi.
dn16:6.22.2: Tāni pi kho pañca bhikkhu-satāni ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā añjalim paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ citakaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā Bhagavato pāde sirasā vandiṃsu.
dn16:6.22.3: Vandite ca pan' āyasmatā Mahā-Kassapena tehi ca pañcahi bhikkhu-satehi, sayam eva Bhagavato citako pajjali. 23.
dn16:6.23.1: Jhāyamānassa pana Bhagavato sarīrassa, yaṃ ahosi chavīti vā camman ti vā maṃsan ti vā nahārūti vā lasikā ti vā tassa n' eva chārikā paññāyittha na masi,
dn16:6.23.3: Seyyathā pi nāma sappissa vā telassa vā jhāyamānassa n' eva chārikā paññāyati na masi,
dn16:6.23.4: evam eva Bhagavato sarīrassa jhāyamānassa yaṃ ahosi chavīti vā camman ti vā maṃsan ti vā nahārūti vā lasikā ti vā tassa n' eva chārikā paññāyittha na masi,
dn16:6.23.6: Tesañ ca pañcannaṃ dussa-yuga-satānaṃ dve va dussāni ḍayhiṃsu yañ ca sabba-abbhantarimaṃ yañ ca bāhiraṃ.
dn16:6.23.7: Daḍḍhe kho pana Bhagavato sarīre antalikkhā udakadhārā pātu bhavitvā Bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi,
dn16:6.23.8: udakasālato pi abbhunnamitvā Bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
dn16:6.23.9: Kosinārakā pi Mallā sabba-gandhodakena Bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesuṃ.
dn16:6.23.10: Atha kho Kosinārakā Mallā Bhagavato sarīrāni sattāhaṃ santhāgāre satti-pañjaraṃ karitvā dhanu-pākāraṃ parikkhipitvā naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkariṃsu parikariṃsu mānesuṃ pūjesuṃ. 24.
dn16:6.24.1: Assosi kho Rājā Māgadho Ajāta-sattu Vedehi-putto:
dn16:6.24.3: Atha kho Rājā Māgadho Ajāta-sattu Vedehi-putto Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesi:
dn16:6.24.4: ‘Bhagavā pi khattiyo aham pi khattiyo. Aham pi arahāmi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, aham pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmīti.'
dn16:6.24.7: Atha kho Vesālikā Licchavī Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.8: ‘Bhagavā pi khattiyo mayam pi khattiyā. Mayam pi arahāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmāti.'
dn16:6.24.11: Atha kho Kāpilavatthavā Sakyā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.12: ‘Bhagavā amhākaṃ ñāti-seṭṭho. Mayam pi arahāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmāti.'
dn16:6.24.15: Atha kho Allakappakā Bulayo Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pahesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.16: ‘Bhagavā pi khattiyo mayam pi khattiyā. Mayam pi arahāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmāti.'
dn16:6.24.19: Atha kho Rāmagāmakā Koliyā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.20: ‘Bhagavā pi khāttiyo mayam pi khattiyā. Mayam pi arahāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmāti.'
dn16:6.24.23: Atha kho Veṭhadīpako brāhmaṇo Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesi:
dn16:6.24.24: ‘Bhagavā pi khattiyo, aham asmi brāhmaṇo. Aham pi arahāmi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, aham pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmīti.'
dn16:6.24.27: Atha kho Pāveyyakā Mallā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtam pahesuṃ:
dn16:6.24.28: ‘Bhagavā pi khattiyo mayam pi khattiyā. Mayam pi arahāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ, mayam pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmāti.' 25.
dn16:6.25.1: Evaṃ vutte Kosinārakā Mallā te saṃghe gaṇe etad avocuṃ:
dn16:6.25.2: ‘Bhagavā amhākaṃ gāma-kkhette parinibbuto. Na mayaṃ dassāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgan' ti.
dn16:6.25.3: Evaṃ vutte Doṇo brāhmaṇo te saṃghe gaṇe etad avoca:
dn16:6.25.6: Na hi sādhu yaṃ uttama-puggalassa Sarīra-
dn16:6.25.12: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa tvaṃ yeva Bhagavato sarīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajāhīti.'
dn16:6.25.13: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho Doṇo brāhmaṇo tesaṃ saṃghānaṃ gaṇānaṃ paṭissutvā Bhagavato sarīrāni aṭṭhadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajitvā te saṃghe gaṇe etad avoca:
dn16:6.25.14: ‘Imaṃ me bhonto kumbhaṃ dadantu, aham pi kumbhassa thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmīti.'
dn16:6.25.15: Adaṃsu kho te Doṇassa brāhmaṇassa kumbhaṃ. 26.
dn16:6.26.3: Atha kho Pipphalivaniyā Moriyā Kosinārakānaṃ Mallānaṃ dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ:
dn16:6.26.4: ‘Bhagavā pi khattiyo mayam pi khattiyā. Mayam pi arahāma Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgaṃ , mayam pi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca karissāmāti.'
dn16:6.26.5: ‘N' atthi Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ bhāgo, vibhattāni Bhagavato sarīrāni,
dn16:6.27.1: Atha kho Rājā Māgadho Ajātasattu Vedehi-putto Rājagahe Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akāsi.
dn16:6.27.2: Vesālikā pi Licchavī Vesāliyaṃ Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.3: Kāpilavatthavā pi Sakyā kapila-vatthusmiṃ Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.4: Allakappakā pi Bulayo Allakappe Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.5: Rāmagāmakā pi Koliyā Rāmagāme Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.6: Veṭhadīpako pi brāhmaṇo Veṭhadīpe Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akāsi.
dn16:6.27.7: Pāveyyakā pi Mallā Pāvāyaṃ Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.8: Kosinārakā pi Mallā Kusinārāyaṃ Bhagavato sarīrānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.9: Doṇo pi brāhmaṇo kumbhassa thūpañ ca mahañ ca akāsi.
dn16:6.27.10: Pipphalivaniyā pi Moriyā Pipphalivane aṅgārānaṃ thūpañ ca mahañ ca akaṃsu.
dn16:6.27.11: Iti aṭṭh' assa sarīra-thūpā navamo kumbha-thūpo dasamo aṅgāra-thūpo.
